rem Infinite string tour
rem https://projecteuler.net/problem=238
rem The infinite string w joins the
rem digits of s(0) = 14025256 and s(n +
rem 1) = s(n)^2 mod 20300713. For each
rem k, p(k) is where the first run of
rem digits with digit sum k starts. Add
rem up p(k) for k up to Top.

use bits
use numbers
use sequences
use io
use cli

arg Top integer = 2000000000000000

rem The string repeats with a period of
rem Len digits and digit sum Dw, so p(k)
rem depends on k mod Dw. With S[i] the
rem digit sums of the first i digits, a
rem run of sum k starts after S[i] when
rem S[i] + k is also a prefix sum, mod
rem Dw. So p(k) is 1 + the first index
rem of the least such S[i]. The residues
rem that work for a sum a are the bits
rem of B, the set of the S[i] mod Dw,
rem turned down by a. Take the sums a in
rem order and give every residue its
rem first a. A whole period then adds
rem Weight; Top adds Top // Dw periods
rem and the residues up to Top mod Dw.
rem The built in popcount is slow on a
rem number this long, so count bits with
rem masks that add the bits in pairs,
rem then in fours and so on, up to 64
rem bit fields that sum to a count less
rem than 2^64 - 1, which is their sum
rem mod it.
fun P W Total rep
  Cur = P
  Width = W
  for
    if Width at least Total
      break
    end
    Cur = Cur bor (Cur shl Width)
    Width = Width * 2
  end
  return Cur
end
fun X popc
  Xs = X shr 1
  A = X - (Xs band M1)
  As = A shr 2
  B = (A band M2) + (As band M2)
  Bs = B shr 4
  C = (B + Bs) band M4
  Cs = C shr 8
  D = (C + Cs) band M8
  Ds = D shr 16
  E = (D + Ds) band M16
  Es = E shr 32
  F = (E + Es) band M32
  return F mod 18446744073709551615
end
Mod = 20300713
Start = 14025256
Pw10 = 10 ** (7 to 0 by -1)
Pw2 = 2 ** (0 to 31 array)
Dw = 0
Cur = Start
for
  for P in Pw10
    Dw += Cur // P mod 10
  end
  Cur = Cur * Cur mod Mod
  if Cur equal Start
    break
  end
end
Nw = Dw // 32 + 2
Words = array shape Nw fill 0
Words 0 = 1
Pre = 0
Cur = Start
for
  for P in Pw10
    Pre += Cur // P mod 10
    if Pre less Dw
      Ix = Pre // 32
      Bt = Pw2 (Pre mod 32)
      Old = Words Ix
      if Old // Bt mod 2 equal 0
        Words Ix = Old + Bt
      end
    end
  end
  Cur = Cur * Cur mod Mod
  if Cur equal Start
    break
  end
end
Nw = Words len
Size = 1
for Step in 1 to 40
  if Size less Nw
    Size = Size * 2
  end
end
Pad = array shape (Size - Nw) fill 0
Ws = concat Words Pad
Width = 32
for Step in 1 to 40
  Nl = Ws len
  if Nl greater 1
    Pair' = Ws reshape (Nl // 2) 2
    Tr = Pair transpose
    Lo' = Tr 0
    Hi' = Tr 1
    Ws = Lo + (Hi shl Width)
    Width = Width * 2
  end
end
B = Ws 0
Full = (1 shl Dw) - 1
Left = Full
M1 = 1 2 Dw rep
M2 = 3 4 Dw rep
M4 = 15 8 Dw rep
M8 = 255 16 Dw rep
M16 = 65535 32 Dw rep
M32 = 4294967295 64 Dw rep
Weight = 0
Part = 0
Mask = (1 shl ((Top mod Dw) + 1)) - 1
Ev = 0
Idx = 0
Pre = 0
Has = true
Cur = Start
Done = false
for
  Begun = false
  for P in Pw10
    if Has and not Done
      Up = B shr Ev
      Dn = B shl (Dw - Ev)
      Turn = (Up bor Dn) band Full
      New = Turn band Left
      Weight += (New popc) * (1 + Idx)
      Cut = (New band Mask) popc
      Part += Cut * (1 + Idx)
      Left = Left bxor New
      Done = Left equal 0
    end
    Dg = Cur // P mod 10
    Has = false
    if Dg greater 0 or Begun
      Begun = true
      Idx += 1
      if Dg greater 0
        Pre += Dg
        Has = true
        Ev = Pre
      end
    end
  end
  if Done
    break
  end
  Cur = Cur * Cur mod Mod
